checks.detail: Good to know before you publish After you publish, you can change your names and wedding date 3 times. Fixing a small typo (up to 2 letters or digits) is free. Everything else — time, venue, schedule, story, photos, details and replies — you can change as often as you like. Your website stays online until September 18, 2028, 12 months after your wedding. Then it becomes a read-only archive.
